desc: Implement the solution in Python using the optimized approach: build prefix counts, identify count==k prefixes, and per-word sets of count==k prefixes.
Compute L_global, total_count_k_len, unique_prefix_for_len, and next_available array.
For each word, compute L_alt using the downward iteration with next_available jumps.
Compute final answer as max(L_global, L_alt[i]) for each i.
Test with provided examples and additional edge cases (k=1, k=n, single word, all same words, etc.).
